name: release-notes-suite
description: Two-stage release pipeline for any product. harvester builds the complete engineering release inventory (every shipped story, bug and defect across the delivery and support boards plus non-ticketed PR/commit deployments); releaser turns an inventory or technical draft into short, benefit-led client release notes in a support-team house style, one variant per client-facing brand. Org specifics (boards, integration partners, plans, brands) are discovered once into a local, git-ignored workspace profile.
